descriptions.__srefill: SN newlib __srefill: prepares a stream for reading (flushing a write stream, restoring after ungetc) and refills its buffer through the read hook.
descriptions.fread: SN newlib fread: copies size*count bytes from the stream buffer with SN's byte copier, refilling as needed; returns the number of whole items read.
descriptions.ungetc: SN newlib ungetc: pushes c back into the buffer or the 10-byte in-FILE ungetc buffer; prints an overflow message and returns EOF when that is full.
descriptions.__swsetup: SN newlib __swsetup: switches a stream to writing (dropping read state), makes its buffer and sets the write space and line-buffer size.
descriptions.sscanf: newlib sscanf: scans the variable arguments from str through a read-only string FILE whose read hook returns 0 (EOF).
